title: coryphopteris dura
intro: Coryphopteris dura, commonly known as Duranta, is a plant species in the Verbenaceae family, native to tropical America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Coryphopteris dura include its antipyretic, antiseptic, and bronchodilatory effects, which help in alleviating symptoms associated with colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of Coryphopteris dura include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
